title: Changer+ Launches Stablecoin-First Self-Custodial Wallet to Make Stablecoins Easier to Use
summary: [PRESS RELEASE – Singapore, Singapore, October 6th, 2026] Multi-chain stablecoin wallet combines simpler transfers, flexible gas-fee options, security features, and practical use cases with one ambition: to become the world’s easiest stablecoin wallet.
